description: Run a full or smoke-test MLX LoRA training cycle for the local fine-tuning project using a repository TOML configuration.

configPath.description: Project-relative TOML containing data and training settings.
configPath.name: configPath

expectedOutputDir.description: Optional project-relative output directory whose adapters.safetensors must exist after the process.
expectedOutputDir.name: expectedOutputDir

projectRoot.description: Absolute fine-tuning project root. Defaults to this repository.
projectRoot.name: projectRoot

requirePreparedDataset.description: Require the training process to confirm non-zero prepared train and validation records.
requirePreparedDataset.name: requirePreparedDataset

smokeTest.description: Run one conservative smoke-training iteration instead of the full configured training.
smokeTest.name: smokeTest

name: finetune_train_adapter

artifactPath.description: Validated adapter artifact path when expectedOutputDir was supplied.
artifactPath.name: artifactPath

artifactPresent.description: Whether the expected adapter artifact exists.
artifactPresent.name: artifactPresent

finiteMetrics.description: Whether reported training and validation losses are finite.
finiteMetrics.name: finiteMetrics

success.description: Whether training completed and all requested dataset, finite-loss and artifact validations passed.
success.name: success

trainRecords.description: Prepared training records confirmed by the training process.
trainRecords.name: trainRecords

validationRecords.description: Prepared validation records confirmed by the training process.
validationRecords.name: validationRecords
